notes.title: Update #3!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hey everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Today I’m bringing you a [b]content update[/b]! We’ve added [b]52 new cards[/b], along with a brand new and much more organized [b]card pack purchasing system[/b] in the store. We’ve also fixed a few bugs—hope you enjoy it![/p][p][/p][h3]Bug Fixes and Improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed the stretched player image when winning or losing a match.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved visual quality for the “Al Palo” and “Alto” graphics.[/p][/*][*][p]Optimized game storage space.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]New Mechanics:[/h3][list][*][p]Added a new card pack purchasing system in the store.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]New Skins:[/h3][list][*][p]We’ve added [b]56 new card skins[/b], including:[/p][olist][*][p]Full 1-peso deck (excluding 10, 11, and 12).[/p][/*][*][p]Full [i]faca-style[/i] sword deck (excluding 10, 11, and 12).[/p][/*][*][p]Full traditional club deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Full traditional sword deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Full traditional cup deck.[/p][/*][*][p]Full traditional gold deck.[/p][/*][*][p]1 of gold (oro) – 2-pesos version.[/p][/*][*][p]7 of gold (oro) – 1-peso version.[/p][/*][/olist][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update #2!
notes.notes: [p][b]Hello everyone![/b][/p][p][/p][p]I received several requests to update the card-playing mechanic, so I made a change — now you can play card vs. card instead of having all cards stacked in the center. I also added a new skin. Thanks for the feedback, and enjoy the game![/p][p][/p][h3]Bugs and issues fixed:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where the "Confident" achievement couldn’t be unlocked.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, after buying many custom cards, the lower rows in the customization screen couldn’t be applied.[/p][/*][*][p]Various fixes to the borders of some sprites.[/p][/*][*][p]Added support for long Envido chains with more than 4, 5, and 6 combinations.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where, if the score was 1–1 in rounds won, the AI would accept "Vale Cuatro" on the third card even when it knew it couldn't win.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved the deck shuffling animation, including side movements and hover effects.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]New mechanics:[/h3][list][*][p]The way cards are played has been changed — they are no longer stacked in the center but now directly face off against the rival's card.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][h3]New skins:[/h3][list][*][p]A new skin has been added for the [b]1 of clubs[/b].[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Update #1!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone![/p][p][/p][p]Have you been enjoying Truco? I hope so! Thank you so much for purchasing the game and leaving reviews. I truly appreciate your interest and support. I want you to know that I'm taking all your feedback seriously and actively working on fixing bugs. I also know that the most requested feature is [b]online mode...[/b][/p][p][/p][p]That’s why I’m announcing that [b]online mode is in development![/b] More news will come on that soon.[/p][p][/p][h3]Bugs and improvements:[/h3][list][*][p]Fixed a bug where moving the mouse to the left edge would reveal hidden buttons.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the Envido + Envido + “No Quiero” score was calculated incorrectly for the AI.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where the player’s profile picture appeared stretched.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed an issue where small cards looked blurry in 1920x1080 resolution.[/p][/*][*][p]Added the ability to view card hierarchy during matches.[/p][/*][*][p]Redesigned the “How to Play” screen for better understanding.[/p][/*][*][p]Improved some title texts for clarity.[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted certain sprites for better display across different resolutions.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed scoring for “No Quiero” in 3 and 4 level Envido chains.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where, after a tie, the next player was not correctly assigned as the hand.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where tying the first and second rounds didn’t trigger a decisive third round.[/p][p][/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Official launch! You can now play TRUCO ARGENTINO!
notes.notes:
[h2]🃏 Official Launch – Version 1.0 is now available![b] [/b]🃏[/h2][p][/p][p]After many months of work, testing, tweaking, and long mate breaks, we're proud to announce that [b]TRUCO ARGENTINO[/b] is now officially available in its final [b]version 1.0[/b].[/p][p]This update marks the [b]full release of the game[/b], and we’d love to share with you everything included in this version:[/p][p][/p][h3]Full Argentine Truco experience[/h3][list][*][p]Traditional mode with [b]Envido, Real Envido, Falta Envido, Truco, Retruco, Vale Cuatro[/b], and [b]Flor[/b] (if enabled).[/p][/*][/list][h3]AI with unique personalities[/h3][list][*][p]Face off against rivals with different playstyles: [b]conservative, aggressive, deceptive, calculating[/b], and more.
You can even let them [b]learn from your moves[/b] to become increasingly challenging.[/p][/*][/list][list][*][p]Each AI reacts differently and has distinct chances of calling, accepting, or bluffing.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Full stats & achievements system[/h3][list][*][p]Track your win streaks, number of Truco calls, victories, defeated AIs, and more.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Customization system[/h3][list][*][p]Buy cards with in-game currency, customize your deck’s design, and switch up the visual style.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Real-time AI reactions[/h3][list][*][p]They’ll mock you, praise you, or put pressure on you depending on how the match is going.[/p][p]Each personality has its own lines and reactions.[/p][/*][/list][h3]Configurable options[/h3][list][*][p]Enable/disable Flor, adjust game speed, difficulty, sound, and more.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]This is just the beginning.[/b][/h3][p]We’re already working on new features, improvements, and content. [b]Thanks for playing, for the support, and for spreading the word![/b][/p][p][/p][p]📝 Leave your feedback here: [url="https://forms.gle/TQvDGM7EVA7dQJEr6"]https://forms.gle/TQvDGM7EVA7dQJEr6[/url][/p][p]If you enjoyed it, [b]leave us a review on Steam — it helps us a lot[/b].[/p][p][/p][p]See you at the table![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Build your own deck!
notes.notes:
[h1][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h1][p]Got another update for you: [b]Card Customization is now part of Truco Argentino.[/b]
This one's for those who are tired of playing with that busted deck you got at the corner store, and want to bring some real flavor to the game.[/p][p]Now you can swap out the designs of cards like the 1 of swords, the 12 of cups, or the 10 of gold.
Some feature iconic characters, some have inside jokes, and some... just make a statement.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/69eae31d74c44397758aead6d5afbbcca77cb51a.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]How does it work?[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Buy new cards in the store using the coins you earn in-game.[/p][/*][*][p]View your full deck and see which designs you’ve got equipped.[/p][/*][*][p]Head to the [b]Customization menu[/b] and build your perfect deck — the one that’s gonna crush your opponent’s spirit.[/p][/*][*][p]Everything you buy stays saved. Once it’s yours, it’s yours for good.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/25bc1c40c19f95bff8bfbe680a70b68f2a026bc0.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2][b]A deck with personality[/b][/h2][list][*][p]You’re not just playing a game — you’re showing who you are.[/p][/*][*][p]Wanna call [i]Truco[/i] while slamming down the World Cup trophy as your 1 of gold? Put [i]Diego[/i] on your 10 of gold? Use the old-school 50 cent coin as your ace? Go for it.[/p][/*][*][p]And in the future, you’ll even be able to [b]suggest your own card ideas[/b] to be added to the game![/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/391c93581ba1f007888f7c4a993b3b58ba986622.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h2] [b]So when does all this drop?[/b][/h2][p]📅 [b]July 9th, 2025[/b][/p][p]On Argentina’s Independence Day, you’ll be able to bring your own deck to the table — and play the way you want to.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Add Truco Argentino to your wishlist[/b], send it to that one friend who always claimed they were unbeatable — and get ready.[/p][p][b]In Truco Argentino, you don’t just take turns — you play with heart, with voice, and with nerves.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ll see you at the table.[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Are you playing against a machine… or your Uncle Leo?
notes.notes:
[h2][b]Hey everyone![/b][/h2][p]Let’s talk about one of the core things that makes [b][i]Truco Argentino[/i][/b] truly special: [i]How does the AI work[/i][b]?[/b][/p][p]The short answer? It’s not just some bot. It’s that one cousin who laughs in your face when he beats you — and somehow always gets away with it.[/p][p]Let’s break down how the AI thinks, reacts, and why every match feels like you're playing against a real person.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]Real personality, not just difficulty[/b][/h3][p]Forget about the kind of AI that just throws the highest card.[/p][p]Here, every bot was crafted with a unique personality — a playstyle, a mindset, and even [b]custom phrases[/b] to mess with you.[/p][p]There’s one that acts shy… until it hits you with a [i]Vale Cuatro[/i] out of nowhere.
Another one folds at the first [i]Truco[/i] but drives you crazy with [i]Envido[/i].
And then there’s the one that plays like it already saw your cards before the match even started.[/p][p]We didn’t just want difficulty levels. We wanted characters — [b]rivals you'd love to beat[/b] (and maybe fear a little).[/p][p][/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/5aeba1f5538a31d158c047c081d0cb09728d5f57.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]So… how does it play?[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]It reads your style:[/b] Play too safe, it’ll pressure you. Bluff too much, it’ll stop falling for it.[/p][/*][*][p][b]It evolves as you play:[/b] Strategies shift even mid-round — it doesn’t stick to patterns.[/p][/*][*][p][b]It reacts with intent:[/b] Every [i]Truco[/i], every fold, every comeback — it’s thinking.[/p][/*][*][p][b]It talks:[/b] Each AI has its own voice and tone. Some polite, some… less so.[/p][/*][/list][p]And if you enable [b]Adaptive AI[/b], it will learn from you over time.
So be careful what habits you teach it — it’ll use them [i]against[/i] you.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]A real example?[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/070c9a429008f1ded9fa7e1c8a2b581ed66e6712.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][h3][b]Yes, you get to choose your opponent[/b][/h3][p]You’ll be able to choose who you face from a full roster of bots — each with a name, description, and a defined playstyle.[/p][p]Feeling bold? Pick the aggressive one.
Having a rough day? Maybe go for the nervous one who folds early.[/p][p]Each bot comes with a different kind of challenge, and the [b]real fun is figuring out how to beat them all[/b].[/p][p]We’re also working on a “random rival” mode — because, just like in real life, you don’t always know who’ll sit across from you.[/p][p][/p][h3] [b]So when does all this drop?[/b][/h3][p][/p][p]📅 [b]July 9th, 2025[/b][/p][p]Yes, Argentina’s Independence Day. And honestly, we can’t think of a better time to let loose, throw some cards down, and yell [i]“Quiero”[/i] like you mean it.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]What’s coming next?[/b][/h3][p]In the next devlogs we’ll show off:[/p][list][*][p]How you can customize your card deck.[/p][/*][*][p]What kind of ridiculous (and glorious) achievements you’ll be able to unlock.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p][b]Add Truco Argentino to your wishlist[/b], send it to that one friend who always claimed they were unbeatable — and get ready.[/p][p]This isn’t just turn-based card play.
[b]This is a battle of nerves, voice, and heart.[/b][/p][p][/p][p]We’ll see you at the table.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: Welcome to Truco Argentino!
notes.notes:
[h1]Hello everyone![/h1]

We’re officially launching [b]Truco Argentino[/b] on Steam, and I’d love to tell you a bit about this game — born from the desire to bring all the fun, competitiveness, passion, and energy of how we play Truco in Argentina to your screen.

[h3]🎴 [u]What is Truco Argentino?[/u][/h3]
It’s a faithful version of the classic Argentine Truco, with real rules and AI opponents with unique personalities. You can even let the AI learn from your moves, adding a whole new level of challenge. The goal? To make you feel like you’re sitting at the table with friends. No gimmicks — just the Truco you know and love.

[h3]💡 [u]What can you expect from the game?[/u][/h3]

- Fast-paced, exciting matches
- AI with distinct playstyles that adapt and surprise you
- Stats and achievements to track your progress
- Customizable decks
- Multiplayer coming soon!
- And of course, regular updates

[h3] 💡 [u]In this space, we’ll be sharing:[/u][/h3]

- Development updates
- Improvements in progress
- News, announcements, and surprises

👉 Add [b]Truco Argentino[/b] to your wishlist so you don’t miss a thing!

[i]Thanks for supporting this project. See you at the table! 🧉🇦🇷[/i]
